sourceNote: QA evolved between the preserved runs. This SHA/manifest identifies the delivered reproduction harness, not an invented per-run source snapshot.

chain.limits: Ancestry and patch checks prove code inclusion; semantic contracts are covered separately by review and runtime tests.

checks.name: php-lint
command: find app bootstrap config routes database tests /source/scripts -name '*.php' -type f -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l

privacy-canary-check
command: import json,sys;x=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]));print(json.dumps(x));assert x["databaseScanned"] and x["databaseCanariesAbsent"] and x["logCanariesAbsent"] and x["containerLogExit"]==0

tests.title: P1-13: owner-signed video/audio policy, fingerprint-confirmed contributor grants and server-authoritative assignment receipts
late permission survives real online hydration with one live stream
equivalent Session replacement keeps the existing stream
real account switch during permission stops the stale result before opening another
leaving before permission resolves releases every late track without reopening
denied permission is recoverable by a single explicit retry
hydrated camera captures offline against an already verified signed assignment policy
P1-26: confirmed contact → explicit owner-signed assignment invitation, no implicit access
P1-25: verified peer → encrypted Contacts & Teams → offline persistence → local removal
P1-09: Free monthly quota accepts three signed creates, rejects fourth without deleting local ciphertext
two browser identities: key-only account, encrypted camera photo, Garage recovery
P1-03: signed recipient key, manual fingerprint, E2EE grant and revoke
P1-04: A creates encrypted assignment, B accepts and submits a photo grant, A decrypts
P1-04: real assignment UI creates, invites, accepts and delivers encrypted photo
P1-12: immutable owner-signed media versions survive Garage+Recovery Key without modifying original or inheriting grants
P1-10: offline E2EE video/audio import → 1 MiB Garage chunks → independent recovered owner decrypt
P1-11: two independently verified accounts exchange 1-key E2EE audio grant, recipient decrypts and owner revokes without deleting original
P1-28: independently confirmed A→B Teams invite → recipient consent → E2EE team read
P1-27: owner-signed encrypted Team → durable local queue → server ACL → offline local read
P1-13: owner-signed video/audio policy, fingerprint-confirmed contributor grants and server-authoritative assignment receipts
P1-10: offline E2EE video/audio import → 1 MiB Garage chunks → independent recovered owner decrypt
P1-11: two independently verified accounts exchange 1-key E2EE audio grant, recipient decrypts and owner revokes without deleting original
independent real A→B→C: epoch integrity, failure recovery and rollback boundaries

diagnostics.error: Redundant DOM rebuild could not find lexbor/html/parser.h; official PHP85 already contains DOM/lexbor. Corrected image builds only pdo_pgsql and zip; baseline PHP85 checked separately.

probe.limit: Contract validator only; historical server millisecond clock was not recorded.

proof.interpretation: The exact historical contract is rejected solely by the strict upper time window in the controlled -3ms replay. This supports a clock/boundary explanation; it does not measure the historical server clock or prove every future 422 has this cause.

privacyPolicy: Only command metadata, statuses, counts, public hashes and allowlisted boolean proofs. Raw errors, traces, keys, identities, canaries, media, cookies and credentials remain private.
